build_unwrap_peft_model: unwrap a PEFT-wrapped model to extract its base model for inspection or training
test_validate_quantization: validate that a quantized model is correctly configured for fine-tuning with PEFT
run_rotate_checkpoints: rotate and delete older checkpoints keeping only the most recent and best model
create_enable_full_determinism: enable full deterministic behavior for reproducible distributed training runs
review_load_sharded_checkpoint: load a sharded model checkpoint efficiently one shard at a time from disk
